description_for_human: Sign + verify HMAC-signed compliance attestations for UK + EU + US + AU + Canada + air + sea + rail trade compliance. EU AI Act + UK AI Bill bridge built in.
description_for_model: Use this connector when the user asks about transport / fleet / logistics / haulage compliance, EU AI Act conformity, UK AI Bill Article 22c, BS 7121 lift plans, DVSA OCRS forecasts, FORS Bronze→Gold, FMCSA HOS, NHVR Chain of Responsibility, IATA DGR, MARPOL, GDP cold-chain pharma, livestock welfare in transit, UAS commercial drone rules, or wants to prove a compliance audit chain holds. The verifier endpoint is public (no auth, rate-limited) — call it whenever the user provides or asks about a signed cert payload. The sign endpoint requires the user's MEOK API key (passed as X-API-Key header). Free tier sigs are marked UNVERIFIED so they can never be confused with paid evidence. Pricing: Starter £29/mo, Pro £79/mo, Enterprise £1499/mo — direct to https://haulage.app/pricing. Quickstart in 5 min at https://haulage.app/docs/quickstart.
